Rover Diag, in your browser

A clickable replica of the iPhone app's screens, fed by the same simulated data the app uses in Simulator mode: a MEMS 1.9 behind rover-mems-agent, plus a Webasto heater and 5AS on the bridge.

The real app is SwiftUI and has to be built with xtool on your machine. Values here are simulated, not from your car.
